meta_description: Janu Vasti (Janu Basti) in Calgary: warm herbal oil held around the knee in a dough ring for 30 minutes. 45 min $90; five sessions $400.

data.lead: Janu Vasti (warm oil held on the knee; also spelled Janu Basti) brings sustained, even warmth to a stiff or tired knee. A dough ring around the kneecap, filled with warm herbal oil, kept warm for half an hour. One knee or both.

data.md:
## What Janu Vasti is

Janu is the knee. The therapy is the same as Kati Vasti, moved to the joint that carries you up Calgary's hills and stairs: a dough ring is shaped around the knee, filled with warm herbal oil, and the oil is kept warm for 25 to 30 minutes. Both knees can be done in one session.

In Ayurvedic terms the knees are a seat of Vata, which is why they are described as the first joints to feel dry, stiff and noisy with age, cold and overuse. Warm oil, held and not rubbed, is the tradition's response.

## What people come for

Clients commonly book Janu Vasti for knees that are stiff in the morning or after sitting, that feel the cold, or that tire on stairs and walks, and as part of recovering their routine after a long time off their feet. The research on Janu Vasti alone is sparse; we offer it as a comfortable, thorough way to warm the knee, not as a treatment for a knee condition. A knee that is swollen, hot, locking, giving way or injured needs your physician or a physiotherapist first.

data.heading: Who it suits
items: Knees that are stiff in the morning or after sitting
Knees that feel the cold or tire on stairs and walks
Runners, hikers and people on their feet all day who want a warm-down
Clients following a consultation plan for joint comfort
Anyone who wants warmth without pressure on the joint

items.title: Check-in
items.text: Five minutes on where the knee feels stiff or tired, what makes it better or worse, and anything new. On a first visit this follows a consultation.

items.title: The dough ring
items.text: You lie on your back with the knee supported. A ring of fresh dough is shaped and pressed onto the skin around the knee, sealed so it will hold oil.

items.title: The oil
items.text: Warm herbal oil, usually sesame-based, fills the ring and covers the skin. As it cools it is drawn off and replaced with warm oil, so the area stays at a steady, comfortable warmth for 25 to 30 minutes.

items.title: Finish and rest
items.text: The ring and oil are removed, the oil is worked lightly into the surrounding muscles, and you rest before getting up slowly. Herbal steam to the area can be added for $25. Keep the area warm and covered on the way home.

data.heading: Who should avoid this
items: Fever, an acute infection, or a knee injury within the last 72 hours
A hot, swollen, red or locking knee: see your physician first
An open wound, rash or skin infection around the knee
Knee surgery or a knee replacement within the last six months, or at any time without your surgeon's agreement
Reduced skin sensation (for example from diabetes or a nerve condition): tell us, and we lower the oil temperature
A sesame or nut allergy, unless we switch the base oil

data.text: Insurance: Janu Vasti is not massage therapy and is not receipted as massage. Booked with Abhyanga, only the massage portion is receipted.
"Vasti" on this page means the external warm-oil therapy only. Internal Vasti (enema therapy) is not offered at this practice and is not advertised anywhere on this site.
